name: Question 9
problem:
The acceleration $a$ at time $t$ of a particle $P$ moving in the $xy$-plane is given by

$$
a(t)=⟨\frac{1}{\sqrt{{t}^{3}}},t⟩,\,t\in (0,\infty ).
$$

Given that the particle has velocity $v=⟨1,-1⟩$ when $t=1,$ calculate the velocity vector of $P$ at time $t=4.$
